scientific_status: post-inspection retrospective development and backward-portability test; not prospective validation

population.overlay_note: The dynamic selector may reject a frozen accepted signal but does not refill a later overlapping opportunity.

forecast_identity.assignment: argmax of the 20 causal loop_score columns at the anchor
forecast_identity.compatibility_invariant: the anchor's current state must be a member of the selected rotation-invariant parent cycle

context_families.current_regime: state at the causal anchor; this identifies the orientation within a rotation-invariant parent loop
context_families.previous_regime: previous_state_1 at the anchor; value 8 is the causal session/start sentinel
context_families.volatility: mean_abs_return_12 bucketed at the 2024 anchor-panel median
context_families.range: bar_range_pct bucketed at the 2024 anchor-panel median
context_families.volume: current historical provider volume divided by the prior 20 sessions' median volume at the same bar ordinal; minimum 10 prior observations; low/high split at 1.0; otherwise unknown
context_families.joint_all: top loop x current regime x previous regime x direction x volatility x range x session x volume

dynamic_selector.update_frequency: once per session before that session's anchors

descriptive_drift.cell: top predicted loop x current regime x horizon
descriptive_drift.profitability: mean net trade return after 5 bps per side is positive

portfolio.daily_construction: compound non-overlapping filled signals within each symbol sleeve, sum sleeves, divide by fixed universe size 20

inference.familywise_adjustment: Holm across primary absolute, versus unfiltered, and versus loop-only endpoints over both periods and all horizons

context_edge_supported_requires: primary cumulative return and mean net trade are positive in both periods at all three horizons
primary paired daily-return 95% lower bound versus unfiltered is above zero in both periods at all three horizons
primary paired daily-return 95% lower bound versus loop-only is above zero in both periods at all three horizons
all 18 primary one-sided bootstrap endpoints pass Holm at 0.05
primary individualized decision coverage is at least 0.20 in both periods at all three horizons
finite_lifetime_supported_requires: primary age 1-10 session mean net trade is positive in both periods at all three horizons
primary age 21+ session mean net trade is lower than age 1-10 in both periods at all three horizons
